title: Men's Running – I Only Run Downhill Tee

seo.title: Funny Running Shirt: I Only Run Downhill Tee
seo.description: A funny running shirt for hill haters: a jogger flies downhill with a climb behind him. Unisex 4.2 oz cotton tee, S-4XL, printed to order. Free size exchange.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

A grinning jogger flies down a steep hill with his arms wide open while a long climb stretches up behind him. This funny running shirt is for the dad, the weekend jogger or the trail friend who loves every downhill mile and refuses to discuss the rest.

The print is a 1950s sports-program scene: a laughing runner in a red headband and singlet, arms spread, bounding down a grassy slope with a steep road rising behind him, in faded red, navy, mustard and cream. I ONLY RUN sits above in slab capitals and DOWNHILL. below in larger letters.

Wear it to the Sunday jog, the park run or the trailhead parking lot, or hand it to the friend who signs up for races because the course drops. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, crew neck
  • 100% combed, ring-spun cotton (heather colors contain polyester)
  • Fabric weight: 4.2 oz/yd² — lightweight
  • Pre-shrunk, side-seamed construction, shoulder-to-shoulder taping
  • Sizes S–4XL
  • Colors: Black, Navy, Dark Grey Heather, Heather Forest, Maroon, Natural, Ash, Athletic Heather
  • Blank product sourced from Nicaragua, Honduras, or the US

Questions

What is the I Only Run Downhill tee?
It is a men's graphic tee from Graphic Tees Co. showing a delighted jogger running down a hill with a steep climb behind him, lettered I ONLY RUN DOWNHILL. It is printed on a Bella+Canvas 3001 in 4.2 oz cotton, so it stays light and cool on a run.

How does the unisex tee fit?
This Graphic Tees Co. tee is a true unisex cut in sizes S through 4XL with a crew neck and side-seamed body. Order your usual size for a classic fit or size up one for a looser look. If the size is off, the first exchange is free.

What is it made of and how do I wash it?
The tee is 100% combed, ring-spun cotton, with heather colors blending in some polyester, at a lightweight 4.2 oz. Wash it inside out in cold water with like colors and tumble dry low. That keeps the red, mustard and navy inks crisp wash after wash.

Is it a good gift for a runner?
Yes. It suits the dad who jogs on Sundays, the friend who hates hills and the runner on your team with a sense of humor. It comes from Graphic Tees Co. at $24.99 in eight colors, sizes S through 4XL, and the free size exchange makes it safe as a birthday or race-day gift.

Can I get it by Christmas?
Order by about December 8 and your Graphic Tees Co. running tee should arrive before Christmas. Each shirt is printed the day you order it, so ship times vary a little by location. Orders over $45 ship free, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess.

How does it fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in S through 4XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit or size up for a looser one.
